candidates.method_claim: Static recompilation of PS2 MIPS code to C++
candidates.status_claim: Early and not playable. The maintainer reports that it boots through the IOP modules and sound driver, passes the memory-card check, renders the health-warning screen, and skips the opening movie, then stops on a black screen before the title. 3D/VU1 rendering is not yet working.

candidates.status_claim: Work in progress. The README reports a byte-identical rebuild of every loadable byte in SLES_514.48, while only 40 of 1,328,837 code bytes (0.0030%) are decompiled; most game code remains included assembly.
candidates.license_assessment: GitHub repository API reports no license metadata; no license is asserted here.

candidates.target_claim: Rage Racer (PAL SCES_006.50; USA SLUS_004.03; Japan SLPS_006.00 v1.0 and v1.1)
candidates.platform_claim: PlayStation (PAL SCES_006.50; USA SLUS_004.03; Japan SLPS_006.00 v1.0/v1.1)
candidates.status_claim: Matching is complete for the PAL executable: the README reports all 1,200 functions and 100% of code bytes matched, with a byte-identical linked executable. It says the USA and Japanese targets have complete source coverage using shared PAL C where possible and region-specific C where needed. Some translation units retain inline or hand-written assembly.
candidates.license_assessment: GitHub API reports NOASSERTION/Other, so no standard license can be confirmed.
